logistics.format: Hands-on threat hunt in INE Virtual Labs (network + endpoint); auto-graded; 3 years validity

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Hands-on network and endpoint hunting with recorded community recognition supports professional analytical delivery; auto-grading, vendor-training focus and limited independent recognition restrain expert interpretation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Hands-on network and endpoint hunting provides useful professional operational evidence despite a two-year profile. Auto-grading, training-provider focus and limited third-party recognition leave reporting and independent investigative judgment less certain.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hands-on hunt across network and endpoint evidence provides applied analytical proof, reinforced by community reputation. Auto-grading and limited independent recognition temper the signal, but it supports professional hunting delivery.
